observations.why: Performed declarative with 'we're switching' ratifies a settled course of action the speaker expects others to act on — decision-grade, not merely a claim being argued.
Flat unhedged assertion of benefits, ready to defend but moveable with evidence — claim-level; no ratification or operational language to lift it to decision.
The arrow notation performs the migration as a settled, load-bearing fact — a declarative that records the decision, not an argument for it.
Unhedged performance assertion presented as fact but without ratification or operational language — claim, not decision.
A fixed timeline stated as a settled commitment the speaker expects others to plan around — decision-grade operational language, not a proposal or estimate.
